blocks.text: Yeh Unit 5 (Partial Fractions) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is partial fraction resolution? Where is it a valuable tool?
(Partial fraction resolution kya hai? Yeh kahan qeemti auzaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rational function ko partial fractions (saada fractions) ke jama ki shakal mein likhna partial fraction resolution (tahleel) kehlata hai. Yeh fractions ke jama ka ulta amal hai aur calculus mein bohat qeemti auzaar hai, jahan mushkil rational function ko saada fractions ke jama mein toda jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Expressing a rational function as a sum of partial fractions is called Partial Fraction Resolution.

blocks.prompt:
2 Distinguish between a conditional equation and an identity.
(Conditional equation aur identity mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Conditional equation: It is an equation in which two algebraic expressions are equal for particular values of the variable

rows: do expressions sirf variable ki khaas qeematon par barabar
do expressions variable ki har qeemat par barabar
is ko hal kar ke woh qeematen nikalte hain
is ka koi khaas hal nahi; har qeemat chalti hai

blocks.prompt:
3 Show that \(x^{2} - 3x - 4 = 0\) is a conditional equation and not an identity.
(Sabit karein ke \(x^{2} - 3x - 4 = 0\) conditional equation hai, identity nahi.)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} - 3x - 4 = (x - 4)(x + 1)\), jo sirf \(x = 4\) aur \(x = -1\) par sifar hai. \(x = 0\) par bayan taraf \(-4 \ne 0\), yani wahan equation ghalat hai. Yeh sirf khaas qeematon par sahi hai: conditional equation.

book_ref.quote: How to tell the two kinds apart: put a few values of

blocks.prompt:
4 Show that \((x - 1)(x + 5) = x^{2} + 4x - 5\) is an identity.
(Sabit karein ke \((x - 1)(x + 5) = x^{2} + 4x - 5\) identity hai.)
blocks.explanation: Zarb kar ke: \((x - 1)(x + 5) = x^{2} + 5x - x - 5 = x^{2} + 4x - 5\). Dono taraf aik hi polynomial hai, is liye \(x\) ki har qeemat par barabar: identity, \((x - 1)(x + 5) \equiv x^{2} + 4x - 5\).

book_ref.quote: Identity: It is an equation which holds good for all values of the variable

blocks.prompt:
5 Write \(\dfrac{3}{x - 1} - \dfrac{1}{x + 2}\) as a single rational fraction.
(\(\dfrac{3}{x - 1} - \dfrac{1}{x + 2}\) ko aik rational fraction ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mushtarik denominator \((x - 1)(x + 2)\): \(3(x + 2) - 1(x - 1) = 3x + 6 - x + 1 = 2x + 7\). Is liye \(\dfrac{3}{x - 1} - \dfrac{1}{x + 2} = \dfrac{2x + 7}{(x - 1)(x + 2)}\).

book_ref.quote: We have learnt in the previous classes how to add two or more rational fractions

blocks.prompt:
6 Add \(\dfrac{1}{x} + \dfrac{2}{x^{2}} + \dfrac{1}{x + 1}\). Which process reverses this addition?
(\(\dfrac{1}{x} + \dfrac{2}{x^{2}} + \dfrac{1}{x + 1}\) ko jama karein. Is jama ka ulta amal kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mushtarik denominator \(x^{2}(x + 1)\): \(x(x + 1) + 2(x + 1) + x^{2} = 2x^{2} + 3x + 2\). Jama \(\dfrac{2x^{2} + 3x + 2}{x^{2}(x + 1)}\) hai. Is aik fraction se wapas teen saada fractions tak jana partial fraction resolution hai.

book_ref.quote: Partial fractions is going backward

blocks.prompt:
7 Define a rational fraction. Is \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 1}{\sqrt{x} + 1}\) a rational fraction?
(Rational fraction ki definition likhein. Kya \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 1}{\sqrt{x} + 1}\) rational fraction hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\), jahan \(P(x)\) aur \(Q(x)\) haqeeqi coefficients wale polynomials hon aur \(Q(x) \ne 0\), rational fraction hai. \(\sqrt{x} + 1\) polynomial nahi (power \(\frac{1}{2}\) poora adad nahi), is liye diya gaya expression rational fraction nahi.

book_ref.quote: where \(P(x)\) and \(Q(x)\) are polynomials in \(x\) with real coefficients

blocks.prompt:
8 Define a proper rational fraction. Is \(\dfrac{x + 4}{x^{2} - x + 3}\) proper?
(Proper rational fraction ki definition likhein. Kya \(\dfrac{x + 4}{x^{2} - x + 3}\) proper hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) proper hai agar \(P(x)\) ki degree \(Q(x)\) ki degree se kam ho. Yahan numerator ki degree 1 aur denominator ki 2 hai; \(1 < 2\), is liye proper hai.

book_ref.quote: is called a Proper Rational Fraction if the degree of the polynomial

blocks.prompt:
9 Without multiplying out, decide whether \(\dfrac{5x^{2} + 1}{(x + 1)(x - 2)(x + 3)}\) is proper.
(Zarb kiye baghair batayein ke \(\dfrac{5x^{2} + 1}{(x + 1)(x - 2)(x + 3)}\) proper hai ya nahi.)
blocks.explanation: Denominator ki degree \(= 1 + 1 + 1 = 3\) (factors ki degrees ka jama). Numerator ki degree \(= 2\). Chunke \(2 < 3\), fraction proper hai.

book_ref.quote: When the denominator is given as a product, its degree is the sum of the degrees of its factors

blocks.prompt:
10 Is \(\dfrac{8}{x - 7}\) a proper fraction? Give the reason.
(Kya \(\dfrac{8}{x - 7}\) proper fraction hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Haan. Numerator 8 ghair-sifar constant hai, is ki degree 0 hai; denominator \(x - 7\) ki degree 1 hai. Chunke \(0 < 1\), fraction proper hai.

book_ref.quote: Degree = highest power of \(x\); a non-zero constant has degree 0

blocks.prompt:
11 A student says \(\dfrac{100x}{x^{2} + 1}\) is improper because \(100 > 1\). Correct the statement.
(Aik talib-e-ilm kehta hai \(\dfrac{100x}{x^{2} + 1}\) improper hai kyun ke \(100 > 1\). Is baat ki islah karein.)
blocks.explanation: Sirf degrees ginti hain, coefficients nahi. Numerator ki degree 1 aur denominator ki 2 hai; \(1 < 2\), is liye \(\dfrac{100x}{x^{2} + 1}\) proper hai.

book_ref.quote: Comparing coefficients instead of powers

blocks.prompt:
12 Define an improper rational fraction. Is \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 2}{x^{2} - 4x}\) improper?
(Improper rational fraction ki definition likhein. Kya \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 2}{x^{2} - 4x}\) improper hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) improper hai agar \(P(x)\) ki degree \(Q(x)\) ki degree ke barabar ya us se zyada ho. Yahan dono degrees 2 hain; barabar degrees fraction ko improper bana deti hain.

book_ref.quote: is called an Improper Rational Fraction if the degree of the polynomial

blocks.prompt:
13 Distinguish between a proper and an improper rational fraction.
(Proper aur improper rational fraction mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Equal degrees already make a fraction improper

rows: seedha partial fractions mein toot-ta hai

blocks.prompt:
14 Reduce \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 4x + 7}{x + 1}\) to the sum of a polynomial and a proper fraction.
(\(\dfrac{x^{2} + 4x + 7}{x + 1}\) ko polynomial aur proper fraction ke jama mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche diye gaye qadam ba qadam hal dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Any improper rational fraction can be reduced by division to a mixed form

blocks.prompt:
15 Divide \(2x^{3} - x + 5\) by \(x - 1\) and write the improper fraction in mixed form.
(\(2x^{3} - x + 5\) ko \(x - 1\) par taqseem karein aur improper fraction ko mixed form mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche diye gaye qadam ba qadam hal dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Forgetting the gap for a missing power in long division

steps: Khaali jagah bhar kar dividend likhein: \(2x^{3} + 0x^{2} - x + 5\)

blocks.prompt:
16 Write \(\dfrac{x^{3} + 2x^{2} + 3}{x^{2} + 1}\) as a polynomial plus a proper rational fraction.
(\(\dfrac{x^{3} + 2x^{2} + 3}{x^{2} + 1}\) ko polynomial jama proper rational fraction ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche diye gaye qadam ba qadam hal dekhein.

book_ref.quote: consisting of the sum of a polynomial and a proper rational fraction

blocks.prompt:
17 State the theorem on which the evaluation of the coefficients of partial fractions is based.
(Woh theorem likhein jis par partial fractions ke coefficients nikalne ka daromadar hai.)
blocks.explanation: Agar do polynomials variable ki har qeemat par barabar hon to un ki degree aik hi hogi aur dono mein variable ki aik jaisi powers ke coefficients lazman barabar honge.

book_ref.quote: If two polynomials are equal for all values of the variable

blocks.prompt:
18 If \(ax^{3} + (b - 1)x^{2} + 4x - c = 5x^{3} - 2x^{2} + dx + 3\) for all \(x\), find \(a, b, c, d\).
(Agar har \(x\) ke liye \(ax^{3} + (b - 1)x^{2} + 4x - c = 5x^{3} - 2x^{2} + dx + 3\) ho to \(a, b, c, d\) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik jaisi powers ke coefficients barabar karein: \(x^{3}\): \(a = 5\); \(x^{2}\): \(b - 1 = -2 \Rightarrow b = -1\); \(x\): \(4 = d \Rightarrow d = 4\); constant: \(-c = 3 \Rightarrow c = -3\).

book_ref.quote: we match the coefficients of each power of

blocks.prompt:
19 What is the domain of the identity \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 4x + 7}{x + 1} = x + 3 + \dfrac{4}{x + 1}\)? Check it at \(x = 1\).
(Identity \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 4x + 7}{x + 1} = x + 3 + \dfrac{4}{x + 1}\) ka domain kya hai? \(x = 1\) par check karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono taraf har jagah defined hain siwaye jahan \(x + 1 = 0\), is liye domain har haqeeqi \(x \ne -1\) hai. \(x = 1\) par: bayan \(\frac{1 + 4 + 7}{2} = 6\); dayan \(1 + 3 + \frac{4}{2} = 6\). Barabar.

book_ref.quote: The "domain of identity" means all values of

blocks.prompt:
20 Why must an improper fraction be divided before it is resolved into partial fractions?
(Improper fraction ko partial fractions mein todne se pehle taqseem kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har partial fraction khud proper hota hai, aur proper fractions ka jama bhi proper hota hai; is liye woh kabhi improper fraction ke barabar nahi ho sakta. Tareeqa sirf proper fractions par chalta hai. Taqseem se polynomial + proper fraction milta hai, sirf proper hissa toda jata hai; polynomial (quotient) jawab mein rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: The method of 5.1.3 works only on proper fractions.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: \(x = 100\) par proper \(\frac{1}{x - 1} = \frac{1}{99}\), bohat chhota; lekin improper \(\frac{x^{2}}{x - 1} = \frac{10000}{99} \approx 101\), bohat bara. Bara \(x\) lene par proper fractions ka jama sifar ke qareeb jata hai, improper fraction nahi; is liye dono barabar nahi ho sakte.
5.1.3 Resolution of a Rational Fraction P(x)/Q(x) into Partial Fractions

blocks.prompt:
21 Write the main steps of resolving \(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) into partial fractions.
(\(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) ko partial fractions mein todne ke bunyadi qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) \(P(x)\) ki degree \(Q(x)\) se kam ho; warna pehle taqseem. (ii) \(Q(x)\) ke irreducible factors banayein aur partial fractions ki shakal likhein. (iii) Identity ko bayan taraf ke denominator se zarb dein. (iv) \(x\) ki aik jaisi powers ke coefficients barabar karein. (v) Haasil equations ko coefficients ke liye hal karein.

book_ref.quote: Following are the main points of resolving a rational fraction

blocks.prompt:
22 Resolve \(\dfrac{3x - 1}{x(x - 1)}\) into partial fractions.
(\(\dfrac{3x - 1}{x(x - 1)}\) ko partial fractions mein todein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche diye gaye qadam ba qadam hal dekhein.

book_ref.quote: each non-repeated linear factor gets one fraction with an unknown constant on top

blocks.prompt:
23 Resolve \(\dfrac{x - 5}{(x + 1)(x - 2)}\) into partial fractions.
(\(\dfrac{x - 5}{(x + 1)(x - 2)}\) ko partial fractions mein todein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche diye gaye qadam ba qadam hal dekhein.

book_ref.quote: As two sides of the identity are equal for all values of

blocks.prompt:
24 Verify by putting \(x = 0\) that \(\dfrac{x + 7}{(x - 1)(x + 3)} = \dfrac{2}{x - 1} - \dfrac{1}{x + 3}\), and then verify it by adding the right side.
(\(x = 0\) rakh kar check karein ke \(\dfrac{x + 7}{(x - 1)(x + 3)} = \dfrac{2}{x - 1} - \dfrac{1}{x + 3}\), phir dayan taraf jama kar ke tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x = 0\) par: bayan \(\frac{7}{(-1)(3)} = -\frac{7}{3}\); dayan \(-2 - \frac{1}{3} = -\frac{7}{3}\). Jama: \(\frac{2(x + 3) - (x - 1)}{(x - 1)(x + 3)} = \frac{x + 7}{(x - 1)(x + 3)}\). Dono checks mutabiq hain.

book_ref.quote: Adding the partial fractions gives back the original fraction.

blocks.prompt:
25 Distinguish between Case I and Case II of partial fractions.
(Partial fractions ke Case I aur Case II mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: One factor, one fraction: each linear factor

rows: har factor \(x - a\) se aik fraction \(\frac{A}{x - a}\)
har constant factor ka zero rakhne se
sirf sab se oonchi power wala constant zero se; baqi coefficients barabar kar ke

26 Resolve \(\dfrac{3x + 1}{(x - 1)^{2}}\) into partial fractions.
(\(\dfrac{3x + 1}{(x - 1)^{2}}\) ko partial fractions mein todein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche diye gaye qadam ba qadam hal dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Why every power from 1 to

blocks.prompt:
27 Resolve \(\dfrac{x^{2} + x + 2}{x^{2}(x + 1)}\) into partial fractions.
(\(\dfrac{x^{2} + x + 2}{x^{2}(x + 1)}\) ko partial fractions mein todein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche diye gaye qadam ba qadam hal dekhein.

book_ref.quote: If the polynomial \(Q(x)\) has a repeated linear factor

blocks.prompt:
28 Write only the form (with unknown constants) of the partial fractions of \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 1}{(x - 3)(x + 1)^{2}(x^{2} + x + 4)}\).
(\(\dfrac{x^{2} + 1}{(x - 3)(x + 1)^{2}(x^{2} + x + 4)}\) ke partial fractions ki sirf shakal (na-maloom constants ke saath) likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Fraction proper hai (2 < 5). \(x^{2} + x + 4\) irreducible hai (\(1 - 16 = -15 < 0\)). Shakal: \(\dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 1} + \dfrac{C}{(x + 1)^{2}} + \dfrac{Dx + E}{x^{2} + x + 4}\): paanch constants, jo denominator ki degree 5 ke barabar hain.

book_ref.quote: Factorize \(Q(x)\) completely before writing any partial fractions

blocks.prompt:
29 Test whether \(x^{2} + 4x + 5\) and \(x^{2} + 4x - 5\) are irreducible.
(Check karein ke \(x^{2} + 4x + 5\) aur \(x^{2} + 4x - 5\) irreducible hain ya nahi.)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} + 4x + 5\): \(b^{2} - 4ac = 16 - 20 = -4 < 0\), koi haqeeqi root nahi: irreducible. \(x^{2} + 4x - 5\): \(16 + 20 = 36 > 0\); is ke factors \((x + 5)(x - 1)\) hain: irreducible nahi.

book_ref.quote: How to test a quadratic: \(ax^{2} + bx + c\) is irreducible

blocks.prompt:
30 Why is the numerator over an irreducible quadratic factor taken as \(Ax + B\) and not a constant?
(Irreducible quadratic factor ke oopar numerator \(Ax + B\) kyun liya jata hai, constant kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Har partial fraction proper hona chahiye. Degree 2 wale denominator par proper fraction ke numerator ki degree 1 tak ho sakti hai, yani \(Ax + B\). Sirf constant lene se \(x\) wala hissa reh jata hai aur identity aam tor par poori nahi hoti.

book_ref.quote: each non-repeated irreducible quadratic gets a linear numerator

blocks.prompt:
31 Resolve \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 3}{(x^{2} + 1)(x + 1)}\) into partial fractions.
(\(\dfrac{x^{2} + 3}{(x^{2} + 1)(x + 1)}\) ko partial fractions mein todein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche diye gaye qadam ba qadam hal dekhein.

book_ref.quote: If the polynomial \(Q(x)\) contains non-repeated irreducible quadratic factors

steps: \(x^{2}\): \(1 = A + C \Rightarrow A = -1\); constant: \(3 = B + C \Rightarrow B = 1\)

blocks.prompt:
32 Resolve \(\dfrac{3}{x^{3} - 1}\) into partial fractions.
(\(\dfrac{3}{x^{3} - 1}\) ko partial fractions mein todein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche diye gaye qadam ba qadam hal dekhein.

book_ref.quote: For example, \(x^{2} + x + 1\) and \(x^{2} + 3\) are irreducible quadratic factors.

steps: \(x^{2}\): \(0 = A + B \Rightarrow B = -1\); constant: \(3 = A - C \Rightarrow C = -2\)

blocks.prompt:
33 Resolve \(\dfrac{x^{3} + x^{2} + 2}{(x^{2} + 2)^{2}}\) into partial fractions.
(\(\dfrac{x^{3} + x^{2} + 2}{(x^{2} + 2)^{2}}\) ko partial fractions mein todein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeche diye gaye qadam ba qadam hal dekhein.

book_ref.quote: contains a repeated irreducible quadratic factor

blocks.prompt:
34 Write the form of the partial fractions of \(\dfrac{x + 1}{(x^{2} + 3)^{2}(x - 2)}\) and state the number of unknown constants.
(\(\dfrac{x + 1}{(x^{2} + 3)^{2}(x - 2)}\) ke partial fractions ki shakal likhein aur na-maloom constants ki tadaad batayein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} + 3\) irreducible hai aur do baar aaya hai (Case IV); \(x - 2\) linear hai (Case I). Shakal: \(\dfrac{A}{x - 2} + \dfrac{Bx + C}{x^{2} + 3} + \dfrac{Dx + E}{(x^{2} + 3)^{2}}\). Paanch na-maloom, jo denominator ki degree \(4 + 1 = 5\) ke barabar hain.
